item.title: 🟠 Bing Images Flaws Let Crafted SVGs Run Commands as SYSTEM on Microsoft's Servers
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A crafted SVG submitted to Bing's image search ran commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on Microsoft's production image-processing workers, and as root on the Linux machines in the same fleet. XBOW's testing got the same result on workers across different hosts and network ranges, so the problem sat in Bing's image tier, not on one bad machine. item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Kimi K3 Agents Found Redis Zero-Days and Built RCE Exploit, Researchers Say
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Redis shipped seven security releases on July 23 after researchers published authenticated RCE PoCs for stock Redis 6.2.22, 7.4.9, 8.6.4, and 8.8.0. All four chains require RESTORE. The Streams chains also need EVAL and XGROUP; the 8.8.0 chain needs EVAL and the bundled RedisBloom module. Redis says the underlying memory flaws may lead to remote code execution.
